text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ow! Ow, ow, ow!
My head hurts so much!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I have no idea what caused it,
but it hurts like crazy!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Oh well, whatever! Soccer class is next, so I gotta hurry!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll show 'em what I can do,
even with a headache!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: When it hurts, it hurts! I can't concentrate on anything!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
When you're not feeling well, you should just rest properly.
Yeah, that was a good lesson to learn—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! All right, I'll rest.
So please, don't hurt like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For a while after, Epiphaneia's headache persisted.
